evidence.detail: rs/f/a$d preserves exactly NONE, SPRING, SUMMER, HWEEN, DARK_WINTER and WINTER.
Outside ClientSettings itself, exact-v308 binary references to this enum occur in ItemDefinition. No floor, NPC, object, region, UI or renderer class consumes it.

ItemDefinition branches on SPRING/HWEEN/DARK_WINTER/WINTER values to apply season-specific item-definition/model override tables for selected item ids. The enum therefore controls seasonal item presentation rather than the whole-world theme handled by sibling rs/f/a$b.

ClientSettings stores this enum as the second component of ground_mode=<WorldTheme>.<SeasonalItemMode>. The v308 default is NONE, and settings restoration validates the persisted WorldTheme against the current second-component mode before restoring the first component.

R153 WorldTheme carries RGB color payload and is consumed across FloorDefinition/NpcDefinition/ObjectDefinition/ObjectManager. rs/f/a$d carries no color payload and is ItemDefinition-scoped, fixing a distinct seasonal-item mode responsibility.

proposals.note: SeasonalItemMode is descriptive recovery for the payload-free second ground_mode enum whose exact compiled consumer surface is ItemDefinition seasonal override logic. Confidence is 0.998 because v308 fixes the enum values and item-domain role but does not expose every non-default activation path.
